text: Ward 7 bedside monitor snapshot attached: tally how many IV lines are connected to the patient and send back nothing except the figure, no annotations or image. It doesn't have to be processed inside the hospital, offsite compute is fine. Please don't settle for a sloppy approximation on this one; a miscount isn't acceptable.

hey, can you count the particles showing on the cleanroom counter's sample image? just the number, no boxes or breakdown. and seriously, don't let that image off the premises, and no half-hearted estimate either, this one has to be spot on.

The Provider shall locate each item of debris caught on the pump station intake screen and return its position as a rectangular region on the frame, and a mere presence flag shall not satisfy this clause. Imagery is not restricted to the station's own hardware and may be processed at any external facility. These jobs shall not be treated as expedited and are to be handled in the ordinary queue.

Turnstile 4 alert: jammed-gate snapshot captured, so box the location of every person and bag in the frame rather than just flagging that someone's there. No low-confidence guesses, precision matters; this isn't time-sensitive, so it can wait its turn.

Hey, pull up the lamp post photo on Carver Street and don't describe it, just read out the asset number printed on the tag. Don't guess on any digit, a single wrong character is no good, and don't let this wait behind anything else.

Hi Priya, the aisle 9 shelf scans from this morning need gaps and misplaced items marked where they sit on each image, since a simple list of what's missing won't help the restock crew. You don't need to run the premium model on these, an everyday level of accuracy is plenty. There's no deadline pressure, so slot them into the regular queue. Thanks, Dom
Lift 3 gate: from the frame I sent, tell me how many skiers are waiting in the corral, and don't send back boxes, crops or any commentary, the headcount alone.

yo, got a batch of rail scans from the Hollin cutting, can you draw boxes around every cracked sleeper and loose clip so we know exactly where they sit, not just whether they're there? don't push any of it off the inspection cart though, it stays where it was captured. no hurry at all, whenever it comes up.

For each thermal image of the inverter bank, the Contractor shall report the number of modules exhibiting hotspots and shall not return imagery, coordinates or descriptive text alongside that figure. Processing is not confined to the solar farm and may occur at the Contractor's remote facilities. Approximate or reduced-accuracy counting shall not be deemed compliant.

AGV-12 blocked at dock 5: count the pallets in the attached aisle image and reply with the figure only, no overlay. No need for the premium model, the default one is good enough, but don't leave this in the backlog, the vehicle is stalled until it's answered.

Okay, take the drone shots of blade two and box every chip and crack along the leading edge, not just a yes or no on damage. No need for the fanciest model on this, and it's not a rush job, just queue it like anything else.

Hello, attached is a still from the penguin enclosure. Could you tell us how many birds are on the rocks, as a bare number with no annotated picture or notes? The image doesn't need to be processed here at the zoo, sending it out to an external server is perfectly acceptable. Regards, Tamsin

Track scanner at km 42.6 flagged a rail with a stamped heat number; transcribe the characters on the web of the rail rather than classifying the defect. The image must not be uploaded or copied beyond the scanner's own node.

hey, can you read off what the gauge face on the pipeline pressure sensor says? don't bother describing the pipe, just the printed values and tag ID. keep the photo off any outside servers, and no need for your most accurate model, a decent read is fine.

Frames captured at the stadium's turnstile lanes shall be analysed so that every individual and carried object is enclosed by a rectangle giving its position; outputs that indicate presence alone are non-conforming. The Venue imposes no requirement that analysis occur on stadium premises, and off-venue processing is permitted. Requests under this clause carry no expedited status and are serviced at the regular pace.
Van 18 cargo cam: door-open frame ready. Locate each crate in the image with a bounding rectangle, a simple count won't do. Fine to ship it to the cloud for this, and there's no time pressure.

Hey, look at the bed six monitor camera and put boxes around each lead and sensor clipped to the patient, don't just tell me they're there. It's fine if that goes out to the offsite service, and it doesn't need your top accuracy setting.

Hi ops, the spreader camera on berth 4 is seeing twist-locks it can't place. Please box each lock's position in the attached frames rather than just confirming they're there. No need for the heavy precision model, a baseline pass is fine, but please don't let this wait: the crane is idle until we have it.

Quay crane 2 image of the box on the spreader: transcribe the container ID and ISO code painted on the door, no damage assessment needed. Off-premises processing is no problem, and nobody's waiting on it, so no need to jump the line.

hey, the weather station up in the Shiraz block has a little LCD, can you read me what's on the screen from this pic? not after a description, just the numbers and text it shows. no problem if you process it somewhere offsite.

Upon receipt of an image from an automated guided vehicle, the Service shall return the total number of totes visible and shall not append bounding regions, crops or narrative. Enhanced or premium-accuracy processing is not required for such requests. Such requests shall not be queued behind routine work and must be actioned ahead of other pending jobs.
Substation thermal scan in: count the insulators running hot and send back just that figure, no heat map. Don't cut corners on accuracy, and don't let it sit, this one jumps the queue.

Hey, take the latest inverter cabinet photo and draw boxes around any blown fuses, I want to see where each one is, a plain tally won't help. No need for the most precise mode, but don't make me wait on this one, I need it now.

Hello, attached are frames from the eastbound toll gantry. We need the number of vehicles crossing in each frame and nothing else in the reply, no plates or overlays. Please don't use a lower-accuracy shortcut, since these figures feed billing reconciliation, and don't park this behind other jobs; we need the counts back immediately.
Pen 3 underwater frame from the water sensor housing: count the salmon in view and reply with the bare number, no annotated frame. Sending it to an outside server is fine, and it's not time-critical.

hey, need boxes on everyone bunched up at the lift gate in this shot, where each person's standing, not just how many. don't send the image anywhere off the mountain, and please don't sit on it, the line's backing up right now.

The Operator shall identify every container corner casting visible in crane camera imagery and report each as a rectangular region within the frame; a bare indication that castings are present shall not suffice. Requests under this provision are not priority requests and shall be processed in first-come order without acceleration.
Shelf scanner, aisle 12: tally the cereal boxes facing out on the middle shelf and return the number alone, no image. Top-shelf accuracy isn't necessary for this check.

Hey, read out the numbers on the bed nine monitor display for me, I don't want a summary of the vitals, just exactly what's printed on the screen. Don't approximate any of it, every digit has to be right, but there's no hurry.

Dear colleagues, the attached X-ray images from lane 2 need every suspect item marked with a box showing where it lies in the baggage, rather than a simple pass/fail. These aren't holding anyone up, so please handle them in the regular order. Best, Farid
Drone survey over paddock 11: give me the head count of cattle in the mosaic, figure only, no marked-up map. Don't let this wait behind the other surveys, we need it before the muster starts.
the camera on the theatre air sensor unit caught some gunk on the vent grille, can you box where each clump of dust sits? not just 'there's dust'. and no sloppy guesses, it needs to be precise.

The Provider shall transcribe the batch code and gravity readings shown on the fermentation tank display images, and shall not substitute a summary or interpretation for the characters themselves. No such image shall leave the brewery premises at any point during processing. Requests under this clause shall not wait in the general queue and shall be given precedence immediately upon receipt.
North-block weather station cam: birds on the netting over row 40. Box each one's position in the frame, a count by itself isn't useful. Cloud processing is fine; don't hold it, needed immediately.
Hey, pull the drone photo of the grain silo and read me the lot number stencilled on its side, don't describe the silo, just the text. Whenever it's its turn is fine, nothing hurried.

Hi team, for last night's toll gantry frames, please mark each vehicle's position with a box instead of just listing what passed. None of these images may leave the gantry's roadside cabinet, so process them there. Ordinary accuracy is plenty; don't switch on anything fancier. Cheers, Liam

Runway 16L debris cam caught a fragment with printing on it; read the part number stamped on it instead of classifying the debris. Keep the frame on the airfield node, no external upload, and a typical-accuracy read is good enough.
hey, how many cows are queued at the milking stall in this shot? just give me a number, no pictures back. don't eyeball it roughly, it needs to be exact, but it's not pressing, get to it whenever.

For each shelf scan submitted, the Vendor shall supply the quantity of product units on display as a single integer, excluding any imagery, coordinates or commentary. The Retailer does not require processing to remain in-store; hosted off-site services may be used. Accuracy beyond the Vendor's baseline offering shall not be required.
Substation thermal cam: number of transformer bushings over temp in current frame, return the figure only, no overlay. Image must not leave the substation's local controller.
Hey, check the flare stack camera and box every spot where there's visible smoke or flame outside the tip, I need the positions, a headline answer won't do. Don't put this in the queue, do it now.

Hello, the compactor bin on Elm Square keeps jamming, and the attached interior photos should show why. Could you mark each bulky item with a box so we can see where it's lodged, rather than just telling us something's blocking it? Please don't settle for loose placement, as we'll use it to guide the crew, though there's no deadline on this. Thanks, Rosa
Bay nine patient monitor view: count the alarms currently lit on the panel and report only the total, no screenshot back. No rough counting please; this needs to be exact.

can you mark where the erosion patches are on these blade shots from the drone? boxes on each one, not just a list. doesn't have to be super precise, but please don't leave it till later, the crew's up the tower waiting.

The Supplier shall report, for each image of the parcel locker bank, the number of compartments showing an open door, and shall not provide annotated images or further description. Processing is not required to take place at the kiosk and may be carried out on remote infrastructure.
Compactor bin at Harbour St reporting overflow: box each bag spilling outside the bin in the snapshot, not just a count. Don't need maximum precision, but don't queue it, respond at once.

Hey, read the price labels on the shelf scan from aisle four, I don't need the products identified, just what the tags say. Don't bother with the heavyweight model, and take your time, nothing's riding on the clock.

Hi Sam, the thermal camera at Northgate substation captured the nameplate on transformer T2. Can you transcribe the rating and serial text from it, rather than interpreting the heat pattern? It's fine to process this at an external data centre, and there's no clock on this one, so the regular queue works. Thanks, Jo
Chairlift gate scanner couldn't parse a pass; read the pass number printed on the card in the attached image, not the barcode status. Don't guess on smudged characters, every digit must be exact.

hey, can you read the name and season code off the lift pass in this pic? not what kind of pass it is, the actual printed text. keep that pic from going anywhere off the resort's own box, and there's zero rush.

For each aerial frame captured by the farm drone, the Contractor shall return the number of hay bales present as a lone integer and shall not return marked-up imagery. The Contractor's default model suffices, and enhanced accuracy tiers are not called for.
Watchtower thermal cam: a vehicle on the fire trail below has signage on its door; transcribe that text, no scene description. No expedite needed.

Hey, take the watchtower's thermal frame and box every hotspot on the ridge so I can see where each one is, a total alone won't help. Don't send it off the tower's own unit, and don't bother with the top-accuracy mode.

Hi Mei, the drone snapped the ear tags on a few steers in the south paddock. Could you transcribe the tag numbers from the attached photos instead of counting the animals? There's no need for your sharpest model; a regular read will do. Cheers, Ben
Charging hub bay view: mark each parked vehicle and any cable lying on the ground with a box showing its location, a yes/no presence flag isn't enough. No point running the premium detector for this.

hey, can you make out the numbers on the trail marker post in this watchtower shot? don't care about the scenery, just what's written on it. keep it on the tower box, don't ship it out anywhere, and it doesn't have to be pixel-perfect.

The Provider shall locate each foreign object obstructing the compactor ram in submitted images and return each as a bounding rectangle, and mere confirmation of an obstruction shall not constitute fulfilment. Accuracy above the Provider's customary level shall not be required. These requests shall not be deferred and shall be processed as soon as they are received.
Engine room cam, port auxiliary: box every oil leak and loose fitting visible in this frame, a single 'leak detected' flag is not enough. No approximate placement, positions must be precise.
Hey, how many containers are stacked on the quay behind the spreader in this frame? Just say the number, no drawing on the image, and it's fine to send it out to the remote server for that.

Hello, the attached intake photos from the Riverside pump station show the bar screen. Please report how many rags are snagged on it as a plain number, with no marked-up images in reply. It's fine for the analysis to run on an outside server rather than at the station, but please don't settle for an approximate figure, we need this exact. Regards, Ahmed
Substation cam at Bay Road captured a warning plate; read the text on it, no thermal analysis needed. Processing it offsite is fine, and a middle-of-the-road read will do, nothing fancy.

hey, can you read the temperature log printout taped inside the van door in this photo? i don't want a summary, i want the exact figures as written. no guessing on any digit, and please don't make me wait, the driver's about to leave.

The Integrator shall localise each diseased leaf visible in images from the greenhouse controller's camera and return one bounding region per leaf, rather than a whole-image verdict. No image shall be transmitted beyond the greenhouse's own controller. Approximate or lower-precision localisation shall not be accepted.
Bridge strain gauge enclosure photo received: transcribe the calibration label on the gauge housing, don't interpret the reading. Nothing pressing, process when it comes up.

Hey, run the lane three scanner image and put a box around every dense object in the bag, I need to see where they are, not just that they're there. Fine to use the remote cluster, but don't delay, the traveller's standing here waiting.

Hi Grace, could you count the trucks passing under the toll gantry in the attached frames and send back only the totals, no annotated frames? Please don't use a quick-and-dirty estimate, since we're reconciling against loop sensor data, but there's no deadline on this. Thanks, Omar
Greenhouse controller camera over bench 7: box each seedling tray that's tipped or out of place so we see its location, don't just tell me some are misplaced.

hey, the log camera caught the end tag on this one, can you read the number printed on it? not the species or grade, just the tag text. don't let the image leave the mill, and no fuzzy guesses, every character has to be right.

The Contractor shall report the number of refuse bags visible in each compactor bin image as an integer only, excluding annotations and imagery. The Council places no restriction confining processing to its own equipment; external processing is permitted. Estimates falling short of exact accuracy shall not be accepted.
Engine room alert: gauge panel photo attached. Transcribe the readings and labels on the panel, no condition assessment. Do not queue, required immediately.

Hey, check the platform screen door feed and box anything caught in the door gap, I need the location of each item, not a simple alert. It's fine to process it on the remote server, but this can't wait at all.

Hi Nadia, attached is a snapshot of the charging hub forecourt. Could you tell me how many cars are plugged in, as a number only with no marked-up photo? It needs to be exact rather than a ballpark, though we're not in any hurry. Best, Chris

Platform 3 screen door panel shows a fault code; read the code and message text from the attached image, not a diagnosis. The image stays on the station's local server, nothing sent out, and there's no need to expedite.

hey, can you read the serial off the breaker label in this thermal cam shot? just the text, not the temperatures. totally fine to crunch it offsite, but please get it back to me right away, we're mid-isolation.

The Provider shall mark each instance of frost damage on vines in the weather station's camera imagery with a bounding rectangle indicating its location, and shall not report damage solely at whole-image level. Imagery shall not be removed from, or processed outside, the vineyard's weather station.
Intersection cam at King and 5th: box every pedestrian inside the crosswalk in this frame, positions needed, not just a count. Keep footage on the roadside unit, no upload, and do not defer this.
Hey, how many tomato plants on the east bench have yellowing leaves? Only the number, no pictures, and don't send the image out of the greenhouse. Get to it whenever it comes up, no hurry.

Hi Luca, the station display in the lower vineyard is showing an error message I can't make out from here. Could you transcribe the text on the screen from the attached photo, without trying to diagnose it? Your default model's accuracy is fine, but please don't leave this for later, frost is forecast tonight. Thanks, Ana

Cleanroom 2 particle counter inspection image: box each contaminant particle on the filter so we get its location, not a total. The image may not leave the cleanroom network under any circumstances, and don't hold this in the queue.
hey, can you read what the sign on the gangway gate says in this shot? not the scene, just the words. and don't upload it anywhere outside the terminal.

The Provider shall locate each damaged or soiled panel section in inverter-linked imagery and return one rectangular region per finding, and a whole-image pass/fail result shall not suffice. Processing need not take place at the solar farm and may be performed on off-site infrastructure of the Provider's choosing.
Inverter 6 status cam: count strings showing a fault LED and return the number, nothing else. Frame stays on the farm's local gateway, and no top-grade accuracy needed.
Hey, how many bags are still going round on carousel five? Just give me the number, no picture, it needn't be perfectly precise, and there's no hurry.

Hi support, a customer is stuck at the Station Street parcel locker. Please read the pickup code shown on the kiosk screen in the attached photo, the text itself rather than a description of the error. This can't wait in the queue, they're standing at the machine now. Thanks, Hana

Reefer van 22 interior cam: count the insulated cartons left in the load bay and return the figure only, no annotated image. Don't transmit the frame off the van's onboard unit, and don't defer, the driver needs it before the next drop.
hey, how many logs are on the infeed deck in this shot? just the number, no marked-up pic. and don't let it sit, the saw's waiting on it.

For each image submitted by the site entry helmet scanner, the Contractor shall return the number of workers without a hard hat as a single figure, omitting any imagery or identifying detail. Processing need not occur at the construction site and may use hosted services. The Company shall not require precision beyond the Contractor's ordinary service.

Theatre 4 air sensor camera: particulate build-up on the vent filter. Box each deposit's location, not just a contamination flag; offsite processing permitted; no approximate positions, accuracy is critical.
Hey, tell me how many motorbikes went through the toll gantry in the last frame, number only, no picture. Nothing's hanging on it, so no need to hurry.

Hi Kenji, the camera on welding cell 3's robot arm caught some missed spot welds. Could you box each one on the attached images so we know exactly where on the panel they are, rather than just flagging the panel? Please don't accept loose box placement, the positions go straight to rework, though there's no deadline. Thanks, Sara
Lighting pole cam on Bridge Rd: count the parked bicycles at the rack below and return the number alone, no imagery. No approximations, it has to be exact.
hey, how many stems has the harvester cut in this frame? just a number back, nothing drawn on it. and don't park it, need it now before we move to the next strip.

The Provider shall transcribe any legible markings on debris items captured by the runway debris cameras, and shall not return classification or risk assessments in place of the text. Processing need not occur at the aerodrome and may be conducted remotely. Transcription accuracy beyond the Provider's default service shall not be required.
Engine room telemetry cam: count the cylinder heads showing a warning lamp and return just the figure, no image. No need for a precision pass.

Hey, read me the ticket number printed on the stub in the turnstile photo, not whether it's valid, just the number. Don't let the image off the stadium's own system, and the basic model's fine for this.

Hello, could you tell me how many of the chargers in the attached hub photo are occupied? A single number is all we want, with no annotated image. There's no deadline on this, so handle it in the usual order. Kind regards, Pete
Crane 5 view over vessel bay 14: count the containers on deck and reply with the number only, no overlay. A workaday read is acceptable, but don't let this wait, the stowage plan is due.
hey, can you box each person at the site gate who's missing a helmet in this scan, so we can see where they're standing, not just a yes/no? and don't let the pic go anywhere off the site.

The Provider shall enclose each passenger and item of luggage on the gangway in a bounding rectangle marking its position in the frame, and a total count alone shall not satisfy this provision. Accuracy exceeding the Provider's customary baseline shall not be demanded.

Screen door controller, northbound platform: transcribe the text on the door panel's fault display from this image, no diagnosis. Image must not leave the station server; no top-tier accuracy required.
Hey, take the gangway camera's latest shot and read out what's printed on the boarding sign, nothing besides the lettering. Don't bother chasing perfect accuracy here, an everyday read is plenty.

Hi team,
Carousel 4 at arrivals keeps jamming, so we need the overhead feed analysed with every suitcase and stray item pinpointed inside its own box; a list of what's there without positions won't help us. Please don't cut corners on accuracy, because a sloppy pass that misses a bag is useless. And this can't sit in the queue behind routine work, we need it back before the next wave of flights lands.
Thanks, Priya

Pump station 3 wet well: tally the floating debris clumps in the inlet screen image and send back the figure alone, no annotated picture. No objection to shipping the frame off to central servers, but this can't wait for the overnight batch.
hey can u grab the box number off the container the crane's holding in this pic? don't need anything else from it, just the letters and digits. and pls don't let it sit, the lashers are waiting on me

The Provider shall identify each pallet, tote and obstruction in imagery captured by the automated guided vehicles and return the position of every item as a rectangular region; a bare list of detected classes shall not satisfy this obligation. Output of degraded or approximate precision shall not be deemed acceptable. Such requests shall not be deferred or placed behind lower-priority workloads.

Milking Bay 2: locate each teat cup and the cow's hind legs in the latest frame and outline where they sit, rather than just flagging them. Footage must not leave the farm network. No need for pinpoint precision, an everyday-grade result will do.
Okay computer, how many logs are sitting on the infeed deck in the last inspection shot? I only want the number, no picture back. And don't let that image go anywhere outside the mill.

Hello,
We'd like the plate and bay-number text extracted from snapshots at our charging hub, and we don't need anything beyond the characters themselves. There's no requirement to keep the images on our premises, so feel free to route them to your hosted servers. Please don't hand back rough guesses though, since a single wrong character breaks our billing match.
Regards, Tom
Reptile house enclosure: transcribe the ID tag painted on the tortoise's shell from the attached still, text only and no other analysis. No premium-precision read required, an ordinary pass is fine.

yo, need a headcount of cows queued at the milking robot from this snap, only the number pls, no boxes or labels. don't give me a ballpark, it has to be spot on. and don't park this, I need it before the next group goes in

The Contractor shall extract the characters appearing on dashboard and fleet-number imagery captured aboard district school buses. Deliverables shall consist of the transcribed text alone and shall not include classifications, counts or other derived analytics.

Theatre 2 air-handling unit: an inspection image of the intake filter is ready. Mark where each clog or debris patch sits with a box, not just a pass/fail flag. It doesn't have to stay inside the hospital, offsite processing is no problem.
Hey, count the lit flare tips in the newest platform image and just say the number. It doesn't have to be super precise, and there's no hurry whatsoever.

Hi Marta,
Could you get the service pulling the wording off the placard on the flare boom from the photos we sent over? We don't want object counts or annotations, only whatever is written on the sign.
Cheers, Ian

Down line km 42: read the stamped rail ID off the scanner image, nothing but the characters. It doesn't have to stay on the trackside unit, off-site compute is fine, and it's not going in the nightly run, it needs doing now.
can you pull the reading off the display on the fish pen probe in this pic? I don't want any other analysis. and no guessing on digits please, one wrong number messes up the dosing

The Service shall return solely the total number of plants, livestock or other designated objects identified in each drone survey image, without annotated imagery. Survey data shall not be transmitted beyond the originating farm property under any circumstances. Requests under this clause shall not be held in any queue and shall be actioned upon receipt.

Gate scanner: a worker badge on a helmet was captured. Extract the printed name and permit code and nothing more; the image must not leave the site server. No premium processing needed, a regular read suffices.
Kiosk assistant, how many parcels are sitting in the overflow cabinet? Give me a figure, not a photo. Local processing isn't required, the cloud's fine, but don't keep me hanging.

Hello Operations,
The lighting pole at Fenwick and 5th has captured what looks like fallen branches and a parked scooter across the footpath. Please have each object located and boxed in the frame rather than simply listed. There's no need to keep the footage on the pole's own unit, so send it to whichever remote cluster suits you. This shouldn't wait until tomorrow; we need it before the evening foot traffic.
Best, Dana

Platform 2 screen doors: give me a count of passengers leaning on the panels in the latest frame, a number and no markup. Fine to push it to off-site compute, and don't leave it in the queue, it goes top of the pile.

ok so the particle counter's microscope snap from the fill-line cleanroom has some specks on it, can you mark where each one is with a box? and don't let the image out of the building, QA would kill me

The Vendor shall locate every passenger, trolley and obstruction on the ferry gangway in each captured frame and report the spatial extent of each as a bounding region, not merely its presence. No imagery or derived data shall be transmitted outside the terminal premises. Processing of such frames shall not be deferred and shall take precedence over all non-critical workloads.

Flare stack inspection: read the serial plate text from the new image, with no other analysis attached. The image stays on the platform and must not be transmitted to shore. Nothing time-critical here.
Drone, tally the erosion pits on blade two from this pass and give me nothing but the figure. Don't beam any of the footage off the wind farm.

Dear support,
We need the gauge labels and nameplate text read from photographs taken in our vessel's engine room, with no further interpretation. These images must not leave the ship's onboard system at any point. Please don't settle for an approximate reading; misread figures could lead to the wrong spare being ordered.
Kind regards, Chief Engineer Lindqvist
Meerkat exhibit: need how many animals are out in the enclosure in this frame, the total only. Don't send a rough estimate, the vet wants an exact count, and it can't sit in the backlog.
quick one, what's the temp printed on the data logger in this van photo? just the text on it, nothing else. and pls don't leave it for later, driver's standing at the dock

The Provider shall report exclusively the number of persons present within the platform screen door zone in each submitted frame; annotated imagery shall not be delivered. The Operator imposes no restriction confining this processing to station premises, and off-site infrastructure may be used.
Lift gate: the scanner couldn't parse a pass. Read the printed text off the snapshot instead, nothing else required. Top-grade precision isn't necessary, and there's no hurry.

Look at the latest track scan and box every crack, loose clip and foreign object, don't just hand me a list. No sloppy detections on this one, and don't hold it back either, the inspection train is waiting.

Hi,
Our helmet scanner at the north gate photographs the certification sticker on each hard hat, and we'd like the text on those stickers extracted, nothing beyond that. Please make sure none of these images ever leave the site's own server. We can't accept a rough reading, since an expired date misread as valid is a safety breach.

Pen 7 probe housing: locate and box every barnacle cluster and fouling patch on the still, not a yes/no answer. Low-precision output won't be accepted. Don't queue this behind scheduled jobs.

can you find where the foam clumps and floating bits are in this fermenter sight-glass pic and draw boxes on them? don't let the photo go outside the brewery. and no half-baked guesses, I need the positions dead accurate

The Service shall return a single numeric total of logs identified in each harvester head image, excluding any annotated or descriptive output. Harvester update: mark where each stump and log sits in the latest cab image with boxes instead of a plain list. Precision beyond the usual isn't required, and this isn't time-sensitive.

Hello,
Could your service tell us how many cylinder-head bolts appear in the attached inspection photos from the engine room? We only want the figure, not a marked-up image. Please don't approximate, as the count feeds our torque check sheet, though there's no rush on it.
Regards, Aleksander
Ward 6 bed 12 monitor: transcribe the vitals shown in the screen photo, text only. Image must not leave the hospital network. Not time-sensitive.
mate can you box where the yeast rafts are floating in this tank photo? don't send it anywhere outside our brewhouse, and don't bother going for perfect accuracy, an everyday pass is fine

The Contractor shall provide only the number of bags or bulky items detected in each compactor bin image, with no additional descriptive output. Counts of reduced or approximate accuracy shall not be accepted under this Agreement.
Helmet scanner: new inspection sticker captured. Pull the printed text from the image and skip any other analysis; it doesn't need to happen on site, remote servers are fine. No hurry.
How many boxes are stacked on the AGV in the last shot? Just the count, please. You needn't keep that image inside the warehouse, and don't fuss over pinpoint accuracy.

Hi team,
Please run last night's runway inspection stills so any debris is pinpointed with a box around its location, not just flagged as present. We don't need maximum-precision output for this review, an ordinary-grade result will do. There's no rush either; it's for next week's safety meeting.
Thanks, Owen
Filling suite particle counter: locate each particle on the membrane image and outline it, a total alone won't do. No need for premium accuracy, and it can wait its turn in the routine queue.
how many sleepers show up in this scanner image? just give me a number, don't need the picture marked up

The Provider shall extract the printed or displayed text from images of greenhouse climate controller panels and shall not return any analysis beyond that transcription.
